a: An index is a collection of documents with a shared schema-like mapping.
Mappings define field types (text, keyword, date, nested) for indexing behavior.
Analyzers tokenize and normalize text for full-text search.
Query DSL is JSON-based query language for match, term, bool, range, etc.
Aggregations compute metrics and buckets over search results.
Indices are split into primary shards and optional replicas for scale and HA.
Bulk API indexes/updates many documents in one request for speed.
OpenSearch is an open-source fork/distribution related to Elasticsearch.
text is analyzed for full-text; keyword is exact-value for filters/sorts.
Refresh makes new documents searchable; near-real-time by default.
